statusModel.rule: Academic/content status and delivery-page status are independent. An academic status of active does not imply that a dedicated course delivery page exists.

deliveryStates.planned: No dedicated course delivery page is asserted.
deliveryStates.production_ready: Reserved for a future explicit release decision; not inferred from page existence.

notes: Phase 7F-C adds catalog-aligned dedicated instructional course pages for AUT-101, AUT-105, AUT-110, and AUT-115.
The existing /courses/aut-250/ page is the HEV formative-training package crosswalked from catalog AUT-330; it is not the delivery page for catalog AUT-250 Automotive Diagnostics I.
The filesystem contains five dedicated course/training page directories in total, but only four are catalog-aligned Phase 7F-C course pages.
The 64/64 curriculum reference-coverage metric concerns lesson-plan evidence governance and must not be interpreted as 64 built online courses or 64 completed syllabi.
Academic/content status remains independent from delivery-page status; building a page does not promote a course's academic status or authorize assessment.
